Script: app.open("C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe Illustrator 2026/Presets/en_US/Brushes/Artistic/Artistic_Paintbrush.ai"), doc.brushes.getByName("Dry Brush 2").applyTo(pathItem) on a path in that document, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the brush arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Thin-to-medium black dry-brush stroke, streaky broken strands on the descent, rounded end.
